```{r}
#| label: fig-offloading-spectrum
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 6
source(here::here("resources/viz-setup.R"))

spectrum_examples <- tibble(
  position = c(0.12, 0.30, 0.50, 0.75, 0.92),
  label = c(
    "Taschenrechner\nfür Arithmetik",
    "KI prüft\nZitationsformat",
    "Studierender\nüberarbeitet\nKI-Entwurf",
    "Frage an KI ohne\neigenen Versuch",
    "KI schreibt\nden Aufsatz"
  ),
  y_offset = c(0.72, 0.72, 0.76, 0.72, 0.72)
)

gradient_data <- tibble(
  x = seq(0, 1, length.out = 200)
) |>
  mutate(fill_value = x)

ggplot() +
  geom_tile(
    data = gradient_data,
    aes(x = x, y = 0.2, fill = fill_value, width = 0.006, height = 0.15),
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = color_positive, high = color_negative) +
  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = 0, xmax = 1,
    ymin = 0.125, ymax = 0.275,
    fill = NA, color = brand_dark, linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    data = spectrum_examples,
    aes(x = position, xend = position, y = 0.30, yend = 0.50),
    color = brand_dark, linewidth = 0.6
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = spectrum_examples,
    aes(x = position, y = 0.50),
    size = 5, color = brand_dark, fill = "white",
    shape = 21, stroke = 1.5
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = spectrum_examples,
    aes(x = position, y = y_offset, label = label),
    size = 3.3, lineheight = 0.9, fontface = "bold",
    color = brand_dark  ) +
  annotate(
    "text", x = 0, y = 0.04,
    label = "Cognitive Offloading",
    hjust = 0, size = 4.5, fontface = "bold",
    color = color_positive  ) +
  annotate(
    "text", x = 1, y = 0.04,
    label = "Cognitive Outsourcing",
    hjust = 1, size = 4.5, fontface = "bold",
    color = color_negative  ) +
  annotate(
    "segment",
    x = 0, xend = 1, y = -0.08, yend = -0.08,
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm"), ends = "both", type = "closed"),
    color = brand_dark, linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text", x = 0, y = -0.15,
    label = "Lernrelevante Verarbeitung: Erhalten",
    hjust = 0, size = 3.8, fontface = "italic",
    color = color_positive  ) +
  annotate(
    "text", x = 1, y = -0.15,
    label = "Lernrelevante Verarbeitung: Eliminiert",
    hjust = 1, size = 3.8, fontface = "italic",
    color = color_negative  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-0.05, 1.05), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-0.22, 0.95), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(
    title = "Spektrum: Cognitive Offloading vs. Cognitive Outsourcing",
    subtitle = "Nicht jede KI-Nutzung hat die gleiche Auswirkung auf das Lernen"
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold", size = 16, color = brand_dark,
      hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 5)
    ),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      size = 11, color = "#666666",
      hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 20)
    ),
    plot.margin = margin(20, 20, 20, 20)
  )
```
